question: Should `memory-lancedb` grow first-class hybrid/BM25 retrieval with plugin config and fallback behavior, or should LanceDB stay vector-only while hybrid retrieval remains in `memory-core`?
rationale: The requested fix adds official plugin config and changes memory retrieval semantics, which repository policy treats as a product/API decision rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Accept focused LanceDB parity
options.body: Add hybrid retrieval inside `memory-lancedb` with explicit config, verified LanceDB API usage, vector fallback, docs, and tests.

options.title: Defer LanceDB hybrid
options.body: Keep the plugin vector-only and direct users who need BM25 + vector retrieval to the default `memory-core` path until maintainers prioritize LanceDB parity.

options.title: Track a broader memory-search API
options.body: Pause this issue behind a plugin/SDK design if maintainers want a shared memory retrieval abstraction before adding backend-specific hybrid config.

recommendation.title: Accept focused LanceDB parity
recommendation.body: Add hybrid retrieval inside `memory-lancedb` with explicit config, verified LanceDB API usage, vector fallback, docs, and tests.
